title: Page 3
content_zh:
“我来向两位正式介绍一下，这位是殷策，殷先生；她是罗曼曼，是我的好朋友。”
“大鱼，你这是什么意思？”罗曼曼一脸困窘的小声问道。
“介绍新朋友给你认识。”她看向殷策笑道：“我朋友很害羞，这样很可爱吧？”
殷策淡淡的笑着。
罗曼曼红着脸，只想将自己给埋起来，她很忍耐的乖乖坐着。
“快说话啊！”言待榆在她的耳边道。
“殷先生你好。”罗曼曼拘谨的点了一下头。
“你们是怎么认识的？”殷策好奇的问。
“我们是高中同学。”
“曼曼从高中时就很乖巧，连男朋友都不敢交。”言待榆发现到罗曼曼词穷了，急忙帮她补充。
“大鱼──”罗曼曼尴尬的看着她，这有什么好拿来说嘴的？
“那你自己说。”言待榆小声的威胁。
罗曼曼张了张口，绞尽脑汁的想着，“大鱼从高中时就很讲义气，有什么不公平的事都会第一个跳出来抗议，结果引来一群女同学的爱慕。”
言待榆瞪着好友，心里都快急死了──她是要罗曼曼讲她自己的事，扯到她是要做什么？
“女同学？”
“这不是重点。”言待榆笑着打断殷策的疑问，“曼曼，你再说点自己的事情呀。”她好亲切的看向好友。
“我……”
言待榆一口气提着，眼神鼓励着好友勇敢的踏出第一步。
“我去厕所一下。”罗曼曼说完，拿着包包溜到厕所。
来不及阻止罗曼曼的离开，言待榆不好意思的看向殷策，“那……你等一下。”

“没关系。”看她们的互动还挺逗趣的。
不知该和他聊些什么，向来爽朗的言待榆也感到有点别扭，“你待会儿还有事要忙吗？”
如果待会儿他和罗曼曼聊得还不错，看要不要再去看场电影什么的。
“我也很想和罗小姐有个浪漫的约会，但……”殷策叹了一声，没再说下去。
“啊？怎么了？”
“餐厅里人手不足，我等一下就要回去了。”
“这么快？”他也才进来二十分钟。
“对，晚班的工读说家里有事，临时要请假三个月，我必须赶回去帮忙。”
“所以你要连代三个月的晚班吗？”
“是啊！麻烦的是我晚上也有工作要忙。”殷策疲累的揉揉眼睛。
“你有在兼差啊？”言待榆有些同情的看着殷策，这样应该很累吧？
“就先撑到工读生回来吧！”他苦笑了一下。“要是有人可以代班，今天就不用这么赶了。”他故意暗示着。
“找不到人啊？”
“店长希望是有经验的工读生来代班。”他一脸可惜的道：“若有时间，就能多和罗小姐认识了。”
“你工作的地方是什么样子的餐厅？”
“义式料理。”
“晚班是要工作几小时？”
“三小时。”
她有些挣扎的考虑起来，她实在不忍心看到一个善良的人这么辛苦，“要是你忙不过来的话，那我去帮忙好了。”
“这样太委屈你了。”他假意的拒绝着。

“不会，我也正愁没钱赚。”她说谎道。
“这样好吗？”
“当然好，你去问问老板，看什么时候方便面试，如果今天可以上班的话那就更好了，你还可以留下来和曼曼好好的聊一聊。”
“今天的话太赶了，我回去会再跟老板说一声。”晚班工读的缺是从下星期一开始，现在让她去只会增加成本。
此时殷策的手机突然响起，他说了一声抱歉，走到外面去接听；三分钟后回到位子上，一脸困扰的看着她道：“老板要我先回去。”
“哦！你去忙没关系。”
“那罗小姐……”
“我再跟她说，我们下次再约好了；不好意思，我朋友一紧张就会想上厕所，她就是这点可爱。”不忘乘机赞美着罗曼曼。
“我知道。”他拿出名片，“这是餐厅的地址，下星期一你再找店长报到就行了。”
“好，你快去忙你的吧！”她收下名片催促道，等他离开后，露出微笑，觉得自己又做了一件好事。
十分钟后，罗曼曼才慢吞吞的走出来，“大鱼……那位先生呢？”
“走了，你要是再晚个一分钟出来，我就要跟你恩断义绝了。”言待榆的眼中冒出肃杀之气──事事这么罩着她，而她却如此回报。
“大鱼，你不要这样，我没心理准备。”罗曼曼讨好的捏着她的肩。
言待榆的语气变软了，“好吧！可是下次再约你出来，你要是再给我尿遁就试试看。”
“还有下次喔？”
“听我的，殷先生人不错，比你之前那些有的没的对象好太多了，你就给他个机会好不好？”
“可是……可是我有男朋友了……”罗曼曼怯生生的说。
“啊？何时的事？”
“昨天。”罗曼曼一脸愧疚的看着她。
“算我多事。”言待榆闷闷的喝了一大口饮料──现在可好了，要是殷先生真对罗曼曼有好感，之后要怎么跟他解释对方已有对象了？

“大鱼……”
气不过的瞪她一眼，“闭嘴！”
言待榆听着餐厅播放的乡村歌曲，好心情的擦着桌椅──来这里工作已有一星期，虽然常要一、二楼的往返送餐，但她忙得很愉快。
挂在门边的风铃声响起，言待榆看见殷策，一脸惊讶道：“你今天晚上不用工作吗？”
“今天休息。”他将小袋子放在厨房餐台上，“过来吃小蛋糕吧！”
“谢谢。”她拿着自己的那一份吃了一口，惊讶的看着他，“这好好吃，你做的吗？”
“喜欢就多吃一点。”这是他弟弟殷熇做的甜点，他只是顺手拿来借花献佛，好让这尊佛继续替他卖命工作，“在这里打工还习惯吗？”
“习惯，这里的环境我也很喜欢，特别是二楼的沙发椅好软、好舒服。”
“那我就放心了。”
她吃了一口，忍不住再次拍着他的肩赞叹道：“真的好好吃，你还真是有心，特地带小蛋糕来。”
“顺手而已。”这句话是真的。
“你也来了？”此时店长拿着餐盘走出来，看到殷策时有些讶异。
“要吃蛋糕吗？”殷策亲切的问。
“不了。”吃了以后可能会要付出什么惨痛的代价──别人就算了，殷策的食物是绝对不可以乱吃的！“你明天下班后会来这里吗？”
“我有事。”想也知道是餐厅要聚会，他一点都不想参加。
“又有事了？”店长皱起眉头──这个老板实在很不合群。
殷策故意一脸的苦恼样，“我尽量挪时间。”
“店长，殷策他很忙，有什么事我可以帮他。”
啊~啊──她真是个被蒙眼的可怜家伙！店长不能苟同的看向殷策，只见他挑眉得意的回视，唉！这只妖魔……
“这样一直麻烦你，我实在是过意不去。”妖魔露出温雅的笑容。

店长无言的将海报拿到店门外去张贴。
“你不能老是这么好说话，这样会很容易吃亏的。”言待榆一脸的忧心忡忡。
“我不觉得是吃亏。”殷策看她为着自己烦恼的模样，还满可爱的。
“我是把你当朋友才说的，有时候该拒绝的事就要拒绝，当个烂好人可是很辛苦的。”
在他看来，她才是那种不会拒绝人的烂好人。
“对了，我要跟你说一件事。”她有些不安的看向他。
“嗯？”
“罗曼曼已经有对象了，所以……”
“没关系，就当认识个朋友也不错。”反正他对那位罗小姐又没兴趣。
“你能这么想真是不错。”她松了一口气，紧接着又语重心长道：“我发现你跟罗曼曼两个人都太好欺负了，这样是不行的。”
content_en:
"Let me introduce you two formally. This is Yin Ce, Mr. Yin; she is Luo Manman, a good friend of mine."
"Big Fish, what do you mean?" Romanman asked in a low voice with a look of embarrassment.
"Introducing new friends to you." She looked at Yin Ce and smiled: "My friend is very shy. Isn't that cute?"
Yin Ce smiled faintly.
Romanman blushed and just wanted to bury herself. She sat patiently.
"Speak quickly!" Yan Daiyu said in her ear.
"Hello, Mr. Yin." Romanman nodded cautiously.
"How did you meet?" Yin Ce asked curiously.
"We are high school classmates."
"Manman has been very well-behaved since high school. She didn't even dare to have a boyfriend." Yan Taiyu realized that Luo Manman was running out of words and hurriedly helped her fill in the blanks.
"Big fish──" Romanman looked at her awkwardly, what's there to talk about?
"Then you say it yourself." Yan Daiyu threatened in a low voice.
Luo Manman opened his mouth and racked his brains to think, "Big Fish has been very loyal since high school. If anything is unfair, he will be the first to jump out and protest. As a result, he attracted the admiration of a group of female classmates."
Yan Taiyu stared at her friend, feeling almost anxious - she wanted Luo Manman to talk about her own affairs, what was she going to do if she was involved?
"Female classmate?"
"That's not the point." Yan Daiyu interrupted Yin Ce's question with a smile, "Manman, tell me more about yourself." She looked at her friend cordially.
"I..."
Yan Daiyu lifted it in one breath, his eyes encouraging his friend to take the first step bravely.
"I'm going to the toilet." After Romanman finished speaking, he took his bag and slipped to the toilet.
Too late to stop Luo Manman from leaving, Yan Zaiyu looked at Yin Ce sheepishly, "Then... wait a moment."
"It's okay." It was quite funny to see their interaction.
Not knowing what to talk to him about, the always cheerful Yan Taiyu also felt a little awkward, "Do you have anything else to do later?"
If he and Romanman have a good chat later, let's see if they want to go see a movie or something.
"I also want to have a romantic date with Miss Luo, but..." Yin Ce sighed and said no more.
"Ah? What's wrong?"
"The restaurant is understaffed. I'm going back soon."
"So fast?" He had only been in for twenty minutes.
"Yes, the night shift work-study student said that he has something to do at home and needs to take three months off temporarily. I have to rush back to help."
"So you want to work the night shift for three months?"
"Yes! The trouble is that I have work to do at night." Yin Ce rubbed his eyes tiredly.
"Are you working part-time?" Yan Taiyu looked at Yin Ce sympathetically. This must be very tiring, right?
"Just wait until the work-study students come back!" He smiled bitterly. "If someone could take over, we wouldn't have to rush today." He hinted deliberately.
"Can't find anyone?"
"The store manager hopes that experienced work-study students will take over the shift." He said with a pity look on his face: "If I have time, I can get to know Miss Luo more."
“What kind of restaurant is it where you work?”
“Italian cuisine.”
"How many hours do you have to work the night shift?"
"Three hours."
She struggled to think about it. She really couldn't bear to see a kind person working so hard. "If you are too busy, then I will go and help."
"This is too unfair to you." He pretended to refuse.
"No, I'm also worried about not making any money." She lied.
"Is this good?"
"Of course, you can ask the boss when it is convenient for the interview. It would be better if you can go to work today. You can also stay and have a good chat with Manman."
"It's too late to say what I said today. I'll tell the boss again when I get back." The night shift work-study period will start next Monday, and asking her to go now will only increase the cost.
At this time, Yin Ce's cell phone suddenly rang, and he saidHe apologized and went outside to answer the call. He returned to his seat three minutes later, looked at her with a troubled expression and said, "The boss wants me to go back first."
"Oh! It doesn't matter if you go and do your work."
"Miss Na Luo..."
"I told her again that we will make an appointment next time. Sorry, my friend will want to go to the toilet when she is nervous. She is so cute." Don't forget to take the opportunity to praise Romanman.
"I know." He took out his business card, "This is the address of the restaurant. You can just report to the manager next Monday."
"Okay, go and do your work!" she urged, accepting the business card. After he left, she smiled, feeling that she had done another good deed.
Ten minutes later, Roman Man walked out slowly, "Big Fish... where is that gentleman?"
"Let's go. If you come out one minute later, I will break all ties with you." There was a chill in Yan Daiyu's eyes - he protected her in everything, but she reciprocated in this way.
"Big Fish, don't do this, I'm not mentally prepared." Luo Manman squeezed her shoulders flatteringly.
Yan Daiyu's tone softened, "Okay! But next time I ask you out, if you let me urinate again, try it."
"Is there a next time?"
"Listen to me, Mr. Yin is a nice person. He is much better than the previous partners you had, so why don't you just give him a chance?"
"But...but I have a boyfriend..." Romanman said timidly.
"Ah? When did it happen?"
"Yesterday." Romanman looked at her guiltily.
"Calm me for being troublesome." Yan Daiyu took a long sip of the drink in a depressed manner - now it's better. If Mr. Yin really has a crush on Luo Manman, how will he explain to him that he already has a partner?
"Big fish..."
He glared at her angrily, "Shut up!"
Yan Taiyu listened to the country songs played in the restaurant and wiped the tables and chairs in a good mood. She had been working here for a week. Although she often had to go back and forth to deliver food to the first and second floors, she was very busy.
The wind chime hanging by the door rang. When Yan Daiyu saw Yin Ce, he said with a surprised look on his face: "Don't you have to work tonight?"
"It's off today." He placed the small bag on the kitchen table, "Come over and have a small cake!"
"Thank you." She took a bite of her portion and looked at him in surprise, "This is delicious. Did you make it?"
"Eat more if you like it." This was a dessert made by his brother Yin Xuan. He just borrowed flowers to offer to the Buddha so that the Buddha could continue to work hard for him. "Are you still used to working here?"
"I'm used to it. I also like the environment here, especially the sofas and chairs on the second floor, which are so soft and comfortable."
"Then I'll be relieved."
She took a bite and couldn't help but patted his shoulder again and praised: "It's really delicious. You are really thoughtful and brought a small cake specially."
"It's just convenient." This sentence is true.
"Are you here too?" At this time, the store manager came out with a dinner plate and was a little surprised when he saw Yin Ce.
"Want to eat cake?" Yin Ce asked kindly.
"No." You may have to pay a heavy price after eating it--don't worry about others, Yin Ce's food must not be eaten indiscriminately! "Will you be here tomorrow after get off work?"
"I have something to do." He knew there was a party at the restaurant, but he didn't want to attend at all.
"Is something wrong again?" The store manager frowned - this boss is really unsociable.
Yin Ce deliberately looked distressed, "I'll try my best to move the time."
"Store manager, Yin Ce is very busy. I can help him if there is anything he needs."
Ah~ah──she is such a blindfolded poor thing! The store manager looked at Yin Ce with disapproval, and saw him looking back with a proud eyebrow, alas! This monster...
"I'm really sorry that I keep bothering you like this." The demon showed a gentle smile.
The store manager wordlessly took the poster outside the store and put it up.
"You can't always be so talkative, it will be easy to eatLosing money. "Yan Taiyu looked worried.
“I don’t think it’s a disadvantage. "Yin Ce looked cute when he saw her worrying about him.
"I'm just talking to you as a friend. Sometimes you have to refuse things that you should refuse. It's very hard to be a bad person. "
In his opinion, she was the kind of bad person who would never reject someone.
"By the way, I want to tell you something. "She looked at him uneasily.
"Huh? "
"Roman Man already has a partner, so..."
"It doesn't matter, just think of it as meeting a friend. "Anyway, he is not interested in that Miss Luo.
“That’s nice of you to think so. "She breathed a sigh of relief, and then said seriously: "I found that you and Roman Man are both too easy to bully, and this is not okay. "
